title: Earth Observation
author: NASA/JSC
description: ISS032-E-008931 (20 July 2012) --- This picture of the Hawaiian Island chain was photographed by one the Expedition 32 crew members aboard the International Space Station, flying approximately 240 miles above Earth on July 20.  The islands are,  from the left to right, Niihau, Kauai, Oahu, the cluster of Molokai, Lanai and Kahoolawe, Maui and the Big Island.
